_comment: Dev: two environments in one account. Each environment's name must match its instances' MMODAL_ENV tag (case-insensitive). 'domain' is the environment's DNS domain: it gives the environment its Vault address by default (https://vault.<domain>:8200), and Cassandra Cert uses it for its SSM parameter paths ($env_domain) and for cassandra.sh -d, so write it exactly as it appears in the cert (case matters).
label: Dev

_comment: Staging: STG2 shows the override. An explicit vault_addr beats the domain-derived address, so use it when an environment's Vault is on a non-standard port or host. STG1 just uses its domain.
label: Staging

_comment: Prod: an account with a single environment still lists it, so it gets a domain (Vault address and Cassandra Cert both come from it).
label: Prod

_comment: Sandbox: the older style, still supported. With no 'environments', an account-level vault_addr is the Vault address for the whole account. Without a domain, Cassandra Cert has nothing to work from for this account.
label: Sandbox
